Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian brickvision · generated: BrickVision scenes are procedurally generated isometric renders restyled into photographs; the pinned creator card describes a paired model judge checking preservation of layout, using up to three attempts across four style templates without dropping items.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.brickvision.construction.v3

  • Layout preservation is the creator’s paired automated-check account; it does not establish independent pixel-level validation.
  • The blog’s generic Nano-Banana reference and the card’s exact image-model identifier remain version-specific descriptions.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian brickvision · evaluates: BrickVision scores pointing responses by requiring exactly one point per target inside the corresponding segmentation mask, and scores counting responses by exact equality with the reference integer.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.brickvision.scoring.v2

  • The card uses the final answer without reasoning because every coordinate pair counts as a point. Coordinate conventions and the optional pixel mode must be kept with the evaluation configuration.
  • No scorer execution or model-performance ranking is proposed.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian brickvision · dataset size: The BrickVision creator card defines four task types—Crop ID, fine-grained counting, Duplicate and Unpaired—with 250 items each, totaling 1,000 benchmark questions.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.brickvision.task-units.v2

  • Task configurations remain manifestations of one retained BrickVision family; item counts are creator-reported, not a payload recount.
